notes.title: Producer Letter #14 – Dev Status Update and Issues with Wall Collision Detection
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, Producer Morino again! I’ve got more news about ACTION GAME MAKER for you today!
In this 14th Producer Letter, I’d like to share an update on the progress we’ve made since the 13th letter, as well as explain the issues related to wall collision detection that have been occurring since version 1.0.18.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Status Update Since Producer Letter #13[/b][/h2][p]In the previous letter, I mentioned two key points:[/p][olist][*][p]Planned update to Godot 4.4.1[/p][/*][*][p]Returning to the free-style visual scripting link system, based on the Pixel Game Maker MV style.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Development on both of these is progressing smoothly, and barring any major problems, we expect to deliver the update sometime in September. Thank you for your patience while we prepare these major updates![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Issues with Wall Collision Detection Since Version 1.0.18[/b][/h2][p]We sincerely apologize for the instability of wall collision detection behavior that has occurred since version 1.0.18. I would like to report on the cause and our current response. The root issue is a bug that occurred as a result of a major revision to the collision detection system.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why was it necessary to revise the collision detection system?[/b][/h3][p]In Godot, side-view CharacterBody2D collisions are usually determined by methods such as on_floor (ground contact), on_ceiling (ceiling contact), and on_wall (wall contact).
However, because ACTION GAME MAKER also supports top-view games and requires directional collision detection in the visual script FSM, we designed a customized collision detection system.[/p][p]After release, two major issues became apparent in the system used before version 1.0.17:[/p][olist][*][p]In side view, the gap between slope tiles was incorrectly detected as midair.[/p][/*][*][p]After climbing to the top of a slope tile in side view, the state was also incorrectly detected as midair.[/p][/*][/olist][p]To address these issues, we had to revise our collision detection system. Unfortunately, this led to some unexpected bugs. We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused to our users. We are continuing to work on fixes with the goal of ensuring accurate collision detection without impacting performance. If you encounter any issues related to these collision detection system changes, we would greatly appreciate your contacting support immediately.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Until Next Time![/b][/p][p]...and that concludes this Producer Letter. As we are working on the big updates in parallel with bug fixes, there may be some cases where fixes do not make it in immediately. However, please rest assured that all bug reports submitted via the RPG MAKER GUILD forums, Discord, and other official channels are properly ticketed and relayed to the development team. We are addressing them one by one, step by step.[/p][p]We apologize for the continued inconvenience, but we thank you for your ongoing support of our endeavors![/p]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]✨ Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Portal Node Entry/Exit Settings Reverted[/b]
The portal node entry/exit settings have been reverted to the format used [b]prior to v1.0.18[/b].
[b]Reason for the Change:[/b][/p][list][*][p]In versions [b]before v1.0.18[/b], when transitioning from [b]Portal A → Portal B[/b], the [b]entry animation[/b] was configured on [b]Portal A[/b], and the [b]exit animation[/b] on [b]Portal B[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In [b]v1.0.18[/b], both entry and exit animations were set on [b]Portal A[/b] for consistency with the previous product, but this caused issues when a single Portal A transitioned to multiple destinations (e.g., Portal B or C) with different exit animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Since [b]ACTION GAME MAKER[/b] now allows controlling [b]multiple portal transitions via scripts[/b], we have reverted to the older, more flexible approach.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improved Collision Support for Non-GameObject Nodes[/b]
Nodes such as [b]AnimatableBody2D[/b], [b]StaticBody2D[/b], and [b]RigidBody2D[/b] can now properly handle ceiling and one-way collision detection.[/p][list][*][p]The [b]MoveAndJumpSettings[/b] option "Stop rising when touching wall collision" now works on these nodes.[/p][/*][*][p]One-way collisions for these nodes will no longer trigger downward contacts when passing through.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed: Small wall-collision objects could incorrectly trigger downward contact detection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Audio volume was halved after scene transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: [b]VisibleDirection[/b] behavior issues introduced in [b]v1.0.19[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: In the [b]DisplayText[/b] action, text set to display at the "center of a locked object" would not display properly on the [b]second attempt or later[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Actions beyond [b]20 items[/b] could not be edited properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Locking an object while it's moving via [b]template movement[/b] could cause crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Visual Script memory leak issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Several translation inconsistencies.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.14 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]⭐ Major Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Parallax2D node now replaces ObjectRoot functionality[/b]
The ObjectRoot node previously handled layer functionality such as bullet/object generation, portal destinations, layer movement, visibility toggling, etc. These responsibilities have now been migrated to [b]Parallax2D nodes[/b].[/p][list][*][p]The ObjectRoot node is still usable but [b]may be removed in a future version[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]A new node [b]ObjectMountTarget[/b] has been added.
It functions similarly to CameraTarget and allows you to specify the generation layer via MountID.
By default, generated objects (e.g. bullets) will still appear on the same layer as the firing object.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Invincibility settings enhancement[/b] (BaseSettings / InvincibleSettings)[/p][list][*][p]You can now [b]disable specific hit collisions during invincibility[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When enabled, those specified collisions will be disabled and [b]“hit” transition conditions will not trigger[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If left unspecified, behavior remains as in versions prior to 1.0.12.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Save file encryption added[/b][/p][list][*][p]New options under Project Settings > Application > Save and Load allow enabling [b]encryption and setting a key[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Encryption is [b]enabled by default[/b], but to maintain compatibility with previous versions' save files, you may [b]disable this feature[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added an option in Editor Settings > Editor > VisualScript to [b]disable the Visual Script minimap[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted jump[/b] now works [b]across multiple checked states[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The "Change Texture" action now allows [b]selecting specific root image nodes[/b] to avoid changing all child textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]new sample project: “Perfect Dodge Boss Battle”[/b],
featuring a boss battle, perfect dodging mechanics, HP bar animations, and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed ObjectRoot[/b] from the tutorial project to reflect the new standard.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]rapid lock/unlock toggling[/b] failed.[/p][quote][p]⚠ Lock/unlock checks happen once per frame, so ON→OFF→ON in a single state without any wait may [b]not trigger the OFF state[/b].[/p][/quote][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug allowing [b]default variable names to be edited[/b] (now locked to prevent dependency errors).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]read-only variables (e.g., taken_damage) could not be used as sources[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]timers without a stop count[/b] did not drop into negative values as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved precision in the condition [b]“Switch/Variable has changed”[/b] by factoring in [b]floating-point equality tolerance[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]instanced portals were not being detected[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]flipped connection points were not reflected[/b] during “Move Object” operations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]variable changes inside AnimationPlayer[/b] were not applied correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues where [b]camera zoom did not function correctly[/b] under some conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the [b]“Baz Menu Sample”[/b] where portals did not work properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated various translations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Boolean (Bool)[/b] type to the [b]Database[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Float[/b] type to the [b]Database[/b].
→ The previous “Numeric” type has been renamed to [b]“Int”[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed the database type [b]“Icon”[/b] to [b]“Image”[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When importing CSVs into the database, [b]empty cells will now be filled with default values[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]visibility of the initial scene[/b] for scene transitions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Read-only variables and switches[/b] are now hidden from the [b]Change Property[/b] action.[/p][/*][*][p]The object variables [b]position_x / y[/b] and [b]scale_x / y[/b] are now [b]editable (no longer read-only)[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Changing position will automatically update the object's [b]global_position[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Changing scale will update the object's [b]scale[/b] property.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]stacked timer counts[/b] would cause [b]accelerated counting[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]homing bullets[/b] with [b]less than 1 second minimum homing time[/b] would begin tracking immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]hit stop under 1 second[/b] did not activate correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]"Change Camera" action[/b] sometimes failed to execute properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]characters appeared in the topmost layer[/b] after portal transitions, regardless of the portal’s assigned layer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the condition [b]“ContactWithHitArea”[/b] triggered even when colliding with [b]disabled collision shapes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated several translations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [b]execution action array[/b] now appears [b]expanded by default[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]ZoomCamera2D is now [b]automatically registered to the camera list[/b] when the game starts.[/p][/*][*][p]When switching scene tabs, the [b]Visual Script editor will now automatically switch to the corresponding scene’s script[/b].
→ This behavior can be toggled on/off in:
Editor Settings > Editor > VisualScript.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where specifying a [b]very short arrival time (< 1 second)[/b] in [b]Move to Coordinates[/b] could cause the movement to fail.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash during test play caused by errors in [b]Show Effect[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where variables [b]could not be incremented or decremented[/b] while the [b]timer was actively counting[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, if a [b]variable was assigned and then used for timer counting within the same Visual Script[/b], the value was [b]not applied correctly[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]When placing an object using a [b]StartPoint node[/b], a [b]preview of the placed scene[/b] is now displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]"Camera" property[/b] to the [b]"Change Game Speed"[/b] action to specify which camera the effect applies to.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where variable changes triggered by [b]non-action components[/b] (e.g., AnimationPlayer) were [b]not reflected immediately[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]damage was not applied[/b] when an attack hit [b]two objects at the same time[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where changing the [b]speed_scale of an AnimationPlayer[/b] had no effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unnamed arguments in [b]VariableSettings[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred when performing [b]object lock operations[/b] on objects [b]without a collision shape[/b] in the scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an [b]outdated version of the export template[/b] was used.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]transitions could still be triggered[/b] even when [b]game speed was set to 0[/b] via the "Change Game Speed" action.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated several translations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]shortcut key to toggle fullscreen mode[/b] during gameplay.
→ Default is [b]Alt + Enter[/b], and it can be changed via:
Project Settings > General > Debug > Settings[/p][quote][p][i]Note: By default, stretch mode is disabled. It is recommended to change it to viewport or other options via:[/i]
Project Settings > General > Display > Window.[/p][/quote][/*][*][p]The [b]reset key and fullscreen toggle key[/b] now also work in [b]exported games[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]“Display Text”[/b] action now supports [b]anchor functionality[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated translations.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]editor could not launch[/b] in some older [b]OpenGL environments[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed detection logic for [b]collisions with one-way platforms[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]mouse mode was not set to ignore[/b] in some sample projects.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version Ends on June 20 (Fri)
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for your continued support of [b]ACTION GAME MAKER[/b].[/p][p]As previously announced, the [b]distribution of the demo version[/b] will end on:
[b]June 20 (Fri), 16:00 JST / 00:00 PDT[/b].[/p][p]We sincerely hope you will continue enjoying the [b]full version[/b] after that.[/p]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Changed how the [b]editor version is managed[/b].
→ The version.py file now handles the [b]Godot version[/b], which may help resolve issues related to [b]GD Extension version compatibility[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Change Object Property[/b] action can now target a [b]parent object without needing to specify a scene[/b]. → Note: To display the dropdown list for variables/switches, object specification is still required initially. After selecting a variable or switch, the action will still work as long as an object with the same variable/switch name exists in the hierarchy.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]states could not be created or pasted[/b] while a group was selected in Visual Script.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]scene transitions did not trigger[/b] even when transition conditions were met via variables at scene start or upon transition completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]logic conditions failed to trigger correctly when more than four were connected[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with [b]some objects in the Tutorial Project[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When executing RemoveSelf, the system will now display an [b]error[/b] if the object has already been deleted via actions like ChangeObject.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred when [b]multiple scenes were deleted simultaneously during scene transitions[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Multiple editor instances[/b] can now be launched.
→ To do this, run agm.windows.editor.x86_64.exe directly from the [b]Steam installation folder[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new link in the [b]Help menu[/b] to [b]open the DLC folder[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Resolved issues caused by [b]version restrictions in third-party tools[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tile effect variables[/b] can now be detected even with [b]"overlap"-type collisions[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that occurred when executing LockObject while [b]no camera is present in the scene[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]homing feature in bullet settings[/b] was [b]not working properly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]camera following failed[/b] when PositionSmoothing was enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the display name of the Zoom Enabled property in ZoomCamera2D.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]%= operator[/b] did not compute correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated several translations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]SendSignal can now transmit [b]strings[/b] and [b]Vector2 values[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new shortcut command to [b]Visual Script[/b]:
→ Press [b]Ctrl + Shift + D[/b] to create a [b]State Shortcut[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]"About ACTION GAME MAKER"[/b] to the [b]Help menu[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]tooltips for tile effects[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the folder location for storing template data used in templates from AGM_templates to
→ [b]AGMaker/templates/[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]diagonal movement option[/b] in MoveAndJumpSettings is now enabled by default.[/p][/*][*][p]When the [b]initial state is deleted[/b], the [b]state with the oldest ID[/b] will now be set as the new initial state.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug introduced in [b]v1.0.4[/b] where [b]wall detection did not function correctly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect [b]angles for the VisibleDirection variable[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Online Document button had the wrong link[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]state names in the tree view were being auto-translated[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Revised settings for certain objects in the [b]Tutorial Sample project[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected several translations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚠️ [b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [b]homing function in bullet settings[/b] is currently [b]not working as intended[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ⚠ Temporary Downgrade to Version 1.0.3
notes.notes: [h3]⚠ Temporary Downgrade to Version 1.0.3[/h3][p]We have received reports that in [b]version 1.0.4[/b], [b]"collision detection with an object's wall"[/b] is not functioning correctly.[/p][p]As a temporary measure, we have [b]rolled back the distributed version to 1.0.3[/b].[/p][p]You can still switch to [b]version 1.0.2 or 1.0.4[/b] via Steam's [b]beta feature[/b]:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 How to Switch Versions:[/h3][olist][*][p]Open your [b]Steam Library[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Right-click on [b]ACTION GAME MAKER DEMO[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Properties > Betas[/b][/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]“Select the beta you would like to opt into”[/b] dropdown, choose either:[/p][list][*][p]1.0.2[/p][/*][*][p]1.0.4[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101521/fa868807660fda165dcea09f17b574b259295eb0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added an option to [b]ignore the owner[/b] in ContactWithAttackArea and ContactWithHitArea.
→ Prevents behavior like receiving damage from your own attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]When moving in a direction [b]without an assigned animation[/b], the object will now [b]maintain its last facing direction[/b], instead of forcibly switching to the default.
→ This improves support for side-scrolling games with depth, such as belt-scroll action games.[/p][/*][*][p]The default target for [b]HP = 0[/b] conditions is now set to [b]self[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If move enabled is off [b]and[/b] there is no followable CameraTargetSettings, camera focus will now be [b]disabled[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed error messages related to [b]CameraTargetSetting[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when the [b]parent object disappears before a bullet does[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary [b]CameraTargetSettings[/b] from various [b]base template objects[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing effect errors for the [b]smoke effect in treasure chest template objects[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where animations added to [b]AnimationPlayer[/b] were sometimes [b]not recognized by the GameObject[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where newly created [b]float variables were converted to int[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the value of [b]Zoom Max[/b] was being forcibly applied even when [b]Zoom Enabled[/b] was turned off in ZoomCamera2D.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some translations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a new property to BaseSettings:
[b]“Clamp Current HP to Max HP”[/b].
→ When enabled, if the current HP exceeds the maximum HP, it will be clamped to the Max HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]filtering and sorting functions[/b] to the [b]project selection screen[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Fire Bullet[/b] action now works even on [b]GameObjects without VisualScript attached[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When creating new variables/switches, [b]“is_savable” is now enabled by default[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the data storage location for ACTION GAME MAKER-specific data to the [b]AGMaker/ folder[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added the suffix [b]_agm_[/b] to [b]input mappings intended for ACTION GAME MAKER[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]GameObject creation wizard[/b] now includes an option to add a [b]Camera Target Settings Node[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default physics behavior of the [b]Topview Character Base template object[/b] to [b]"Floating"[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]CameraTargetSettings can now be used on [b]non-GameObject nodes[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing [b]F6 to run a specific scene[/b] would trigger an [b]input mapping error[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the [b]Advanced Sample: Mouse Shooter[/b], where the [b]reload never completed[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][b]ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.2 Patch Notes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reflected the latest translation updates from [b]Godot 4.3[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Export templates are now loaded automatically[/b] during export.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default property name display style to [b]Localized[/b].
→ This allows property names that previously appeared in English to now display in [b]localized names[/b].[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]🛠 For users already using the editor:
You can apply this change by going to:
Editor Settings > Interface > Inspector > Default Property Name Display Style
and switching from [b]Capitalized[/b] to [b]Localized[/b].[/p][/quote][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]updates to database column names[/b] were not reflected in VisualScript until reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]Switches/Variables were duplicated[/b] when importing a module.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Afterimage did not work correctly on Sprite2D[/b] after a texture change.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in the [b]Tutorial Project[/b] where [b]mouse coordinates could not be obtained correctly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]missing translations[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h2]ACTION GAME MAKER v1.0.1 Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Added links to tutorial articles within the tutorial project.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Steam could not correctly detect the termination of ACTION GAME MAKER.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the camera position would become incorrect after resetting the game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where, if reset occurred after a scene transition, the game would reset to the final position before the transition.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred when selecting a node [b]without SwitchSettings or VariableSettings[/b] using ChangeAction or CurrentObjectState.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several missing tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some translations.[/p][/*][/list]
